# SaveFlex

> SaveFlex (saveflex.net) is a free, web-based video downloader. Paste a public link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook or X (Twitter) and download the video as MP4. No account, no app and no software install are needed, and it works in any modern browser on iPhone, Android, Windows, macOS and Linux.

Key facts:

- Price: free, supported by ads.
- Account: not required.
- Supported sites: YouTube (videos, Shorts), TikTok (watermark removed when possible), Instagram (Reels, posts, Stories from public accounts), Facebook (videos and Reels from public posts), X / Twitter (videos and GIFs, x.com and twitter.com links).
- Output: MP4 video in the qualities the source provides, from 360p up to 1080p and 4K when available.
- Limits: public content only; private, deleted or region-restricted posts cannot be downloaded; one video per link (no playlists); about 30 requests per minute.
- Intended for personal use. Users are responsible for respecting copyright and each platform's terms.

How it works: copy the video link, paste it into SaveFlex, choose a quality, download.

## Downloaders

- [Free video downloader (all platforms)](https://saveflex.net/): one box for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X links
- [YouTube Downloader](https://saveflex.net/youtube-downloader): YouTube videos and Shorts as MP4 in HD, Full HD or 4K when available
- [TikTok Downloader](https://saveflex.net/tiktok-downloader): TikTok videos without watermark in HD MP4
- [Instagram Downloader](https://saveflex.net/instagram-downloader): Instagram Reels, video posts and Stories from public accounts
- [Facebook Downloader](https://saveflex.net/facebook-downloader): Facebook videos and Reels in HD or SD
- [X (Twitter) Downloader](https://saveflex.net/x-downloader): videos and GIFs from X posts, x.com and twitter.com links
